description: Land Acquisition - Thalangamuwa, Naula D/S Division, Matale District
categorisation: This gazette content is a land acquisition notice under the Land Acquisition Act, declaring specific parcels of land needed for public purpose. It contains detailed descriptions of multiple land lots with their boundaries, extents, and locations. The content focuses exclusively on land matters (acquisition of property) without involving government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories. The mention of the Minister's name is incidental to the land declaration process and does not include detailed portfolio responsibilities that would shift it to a government classification type.
